scope: The complete reviewed obć-family surface in the four post-EDIT-0014 Latin components: 576 inherited literal obč-family loci, eight contextual recasts containing those loci, three already-spelled soobć sibling recasts, and 568 standalone token edits.
choice: Normalize obč-/občn-/obobč-/najobč- morphology to canonical obć forms, normalize voobće, and recast every sȯobć-family communication calque to the semantically exact cross-branch term publikacija, informacija, komunikacija, prědstaviti, or izvěstiti.
motivation: Official entries establish type-1 obći and obobć- morphology. Merely changing č to ć would preserve malformed inflections such as občosti and an East/South-skewed sȯobć communication family. The exact German sentences distinguish publications, information, communications, and examples presented by correspondents, so those eleven contexts were recast rather than flattened.
alternatives_rejected: Retain the inherited obč spelling and mixed hard/soft morphology.
Perform only a blind č-to-ć glyph substitution, leaving malformed inflections.
Normalize soobč to soobć everywhere despite its branch-skewed type-2 profile and context-specific meanings.
Replace publication, information, and presentation contexts by one generic communication noun.
Leave the complete family unapplied for a future reviewer.
